top_signals.title: Kospi Drops 8% as Samsung, SK Hynix Shares Plunge on AI and Rate Fears
top_signals.summary: A global selloff in semiconductor stocks dragged South Korea’s equity benchmark down 8% on Thursday, underscoring the scale of an investor exodus from the frothiest corners of the AI trade.
